entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and the State.
2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioners in apprehension of arrest for their alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 498-A/323/294/506/420/509/34 of IPC and Section-4 of D.P. Act.
3. Perusal of the FIR reveals that the Informant married to the son of the present Petitioners on dated 11.02.2020, after marriage, she lived happily with their in-laws.
But, after 05 months they demanded more money from her parental house and also demanded an Audi Car but, her parents were unable to fulfill their demand.
On 02.07.2020, the Informant left her in laws house and stayed at her parental house, after that her husband tried to compromise the matter and bring her back to his house.
Then her husband took her // 2 // nude photographs and black mailed her to make viral the same in social media and forged her signature and filed a mutual divorce case against her willingness.

4. Keeping in view the submission and the nature of allegations as emerged from the materials on record, the circumstances appearing, the seriousness and gravity of the offences, while this Court is not inclined to grant the anticipatory bail, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail in connection with C.T Case No.532 of 2023 arising out of Mahila P.S. Case No.
Puspalata Rout & Another vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17895216/
1 50 of 2023 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Bhubaneswar within a period of three weeks hence they shall be admitted to bail on such terms and conditions as would be deemed just and proper by the said court with further conditions that the Petitioners shall appear in person before the learned court below on each date of posting of the case unless specifically exempted by the court concerned and/or consider the prayer U/s.317 Cr.P.C; shall appear before the I.O. as and when required and shall cooperate with the investigation; shall not threaten, intimidate or terrorize the informant ; shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever, while on bail.

The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
